Canvas.DepthPriorityOcclusionHint.zh: 实验性：按立牌锚点深度决定遮挡；同深度时按图层顺序。贴面参与遮挡，画布底色和网格始终位于所有图层下方。
Canvas.DepthPriorityOcclusionHint.en: Experimental: order occlusion by billboard anchor depth, using layer order at equal depth. Surface layers participate; canvas color and grid remain beneath all layers.

Canvas.GridSizeHelp.zh: 格子的边长，使用与矩形宽高相同的画布单位。选中画布工具后，在空白处拖动也可调整；远离主屏中心放大，靠近缩小。
Canvas.GridSizeHelp.en: Cell side length, in the same canvas units as rectangle width and height. With the Canvas tool selected, drag empty space away from the primary-screen center to enlarge it, or toward the center to shrink it.

Canvas.GridSizeLockCountsHint.zh: 格数自动显示四点框内覆盖的范围，包含不完整的格子。
Canvas.GridSizeLockCountsHint.en: Counts show the coverage inside the four-point frame, including partial cells.

Canvas.GridSizeLockHelp.zh: 锁定后，调整四点保留每格代表的画布长度，行列数自动变化，可含小数。网格原点仍跟随中央移动手柄。勾选时画面保持原样；图层和锚点不因切换而移动。关闭透视或重置保留锁定选择；应用画布预设会解除锁定。
Canvas.GridSizeLockHelp.en: When locked, adjusting the four points preserves each cell's canvas length. Counts update automatically and may include fractions. The grid origin still follows the central move handle. Enabling the lock keeps the view unchanged without moving layers or anchors. Turning perspective off or resetting retains the lock; applying a canvas preset clears it.

Canvas.GuideOpacityHint.zh: 仅调整画布工具的参考网格，0% 隐藏。显示实体网格时会进一步减淡。只在本次运行中保留，重启后恢复 100%，不写入画布或预设。
Canvas.GuideOpacityHint.en: Adjust only the Canvas tool's reference grid; 0% hides it. Show grid dims it further. Kept for this run only and reset to 100% after restart, without changing the canvas or presets.

Canvas.HelpText.zh: 按 C 选择画布工具，再次点击画布按钮打开设置。非透视时以参考屏中心为原点，在空白处向外拖动放大网格、向内拖动缩小；透视时拖动角点、边缘或中央手柄调整。“四点定位画布”会临时隐藏其他窗口，完成或取消后恢复。参考网格透明度仅在本次运行中保留，0% 隐藏参考线。Ctrl 暂停吸附，Shift 约束方向。Esc 取消当前拖动；空闲时切回选择工具。切换透视保留原参数；主动修改非透视格长会建立新的平面参考。
Canvas.HelpText.en: Press C to select Canvas; select it again to open settings. In flat mode, drag empty space outward from the reference-screen center to enlarge cells or inward to shrink them. In perspective mode, drag corners, edges or the center. Position canvas with four points temporarily hides other windows and restores them after completion or cancellation. Reference opacity lasts for this run only; 0% hides reference lines. Ctrl bypasses snapping; Shift constrains direction. Esc cancels a drag or returns to Select when idle. Toggling perspective retains its parameters; editing flat cell size creates a new flat reference.

Canvas.InvalidGrid.zh: 列数和行数须为 1 至 256 的整数。
Canvas.InvalidGrid.en: Columns and rows must be integers from 1 to 256.

Canvas.InvalidQuad.zh: 四个角点须构成不交叉的凸四边形。
Canvas.InvalidQuad.en: The four corners must form a convex quadrilateral.

Canvas.UnstableProjection.zh: 透视变换过于极端，请调整四个角。
Canvas.UnstableProjection.en: The perspective is too extreme. Adjust the four corners.

Canvas.SafetyTitle.zh: 处理透视范围外的图层

Canvas.UnsafeLayerSummary.zh: 有 {0} 个图层超出安全绘制范围，需要选择处理方式。
Canvas.UnsafeLayerSummary.en: {0} layers are outside the safe drawing range. Choose how to handle them.

Canvas.SafetyHelpText.zh:
数量包含需要一起处理的关联组合成员，隐藏和锁定图层也在其中。

取消本次调整：恢复本次拖动前的透视和图层状态。

应用并移回图层（推荐）：将图层或整个组合移到四点框内或屏幕上的开阔安全位置，保留原始内容、尺寸及组合关系。找不到合适位置时，此选项不可用。

应用并删除这些图层：删除提示涉及的图层及关联组合成员，包括隐藏和锁定图层。

应用并保留图层（慎用）：应用新透视，保留全部图层的原始内容、尺寸、位置、组合、显隐和锁定状态。越界部分可能被裁剪或暂时不可见，调回原透视后恢复显示。

本次透视调整与图层处理可以一次撤销。
Canvas.SafetyHelpText.en:
The count includes related group members that must be handled together, including hidden and locked layers.

Cancel this adjustment: restore the perspective and layer state from before this gesture.

Apply and move layers back (recommended): move layers or whole groups to an open safe area inside the reference frame or screen, preserving original content, size and group relationships. This option is unavailable if no suitable position is found.

Apply and delete these layers: delete the affected layers and related group members, including hidden and locked layers.

Apply and keep layers (use caution): apply the new perspective while preserving every layer's content, size, position, groups, visibility and locked state. Unsafe parts may be clipped or temporarily hidden until the original perspective is restored.

The perspective adjustment and layer changes can be undone together in one step.

Canvas.RelocateFailed.zh: 无法在保持图层尺寸和组合关系的前提下找到安全位置。可以取消本次调整、删除这些图层，或慎用原样保留。
Canvas.RelocateFailed.en: No safe position was found while preserving layer size and group relationships. Cancel this adjustment, delete these layers, or keep them unchanged with caution.
